name: Your Chatbot Test: Every Staging Lead Checked, Logged and Answered

parameters.content:
## Your Chatbot Test: Every Staging Lead Checked, Logged and Answered

### How it works
- Your chatbot snippet on the staging site posts each lead to one webhook
- Name, email, phone and message are checked the moment they arrive
- Every capture lands in a test sheet, passed or not, with what was missing
- The chatbot gets an answer back: received, or which field it dropped
- Next phase: the same lead becomes a HubSpot contact and a Google Calendar booking

### Setup
- Paste the webhook URL into your code snippet's submit or lead callback
- Share a test sheet with columns for the four fields plus Passed and Missing
- Run five test chats on staging: one complete, one per missing field
- Point the error trigger's alert at the inbox you watch during the test

### What I need from you
- Your chatbot's code snippet and the staging site login
- What the snippet sends today (one sample payload or its docs)
- The inbox that should get missing-field flags
- For the next phase: your CRM login (shown here in HubSpot) and the Google Calendar to book into

## 1 - YOUR STAGING SITE AND CODE SNIPPET

Your parts 1 and 2: the chatbot goes on staging, and its snippet posts every lead to this one webhook. If it posts through your own backend instead, that backend's webhook points here.

nodes.name: Section - 1 - YOUR STAGING SITE AND CODE SNIPPET

parameters.content:
## 2 - TEST THE LEAD AND CONTACT COLLECTION

Your part 3: each lead is checked for name, email, phone and message, whatever the snippet calls those fields.

nodes.name: Section - 2 - TEST THE LEAD AND CONTACT COLLECTION

parameters.content:
## 3 - THE WEBHOOK: LOG EVERY CAPTURE

Your part 4: every capture goes into the test sheet, good or bad, so you can see the test yourself.

nodes.name: Section - 3 - THE WEBHOOK: LOG EVERY CAPTURE

parameters.content:
## 4 - VERIFY IT PASSED CORRECTLY, FLAG WHAT DID NOT

Your parts 5 and 6: a complete lead gets a received reply, a broken one gets flagged with the exact field so troubleshooting starts there.

nodes.name: Section - 4 - VERIFY IT PASSED CORRECTLY, FLAG WHAT DID NOT

parameters.content:
## 5 - NEXT PHASE: YOUR CRM (SHOWN IN HUBSPOT) AND GOOGLE CALENDAR

The onboarding work you named: a verified lead becomes a CRM contact and a booked call. HubSpot stands in for your CRM here. Switched on after the test passes.

nodes.name: Section - 5 - NEXT PHASE: YOUR CRM (SHOWN IN HUBSPOT) AND GOOGLE CALENDAR

parameters.content:
## 6 - IF A RUN BREAKS

Any failed step emails you the step, the error and a link to the run, so no test chat disappears without a trace.
